method: Viewed every shipped card in art/out/fighters/<id>/ by eye: each splash at full 1600x900, plus a per-card sheet with the card at 480 px wide beside its 3D reference (art/.cache/fighters/paint/<sid>_<kind>_3d.png), a face crop at about 3x around plates.face_point, and 128 and 64 px chips (LANCZOS down, then enlarged nearest-neighbour to view). Targeted 2-4x crops of eyes, mouths, feet and edges; the round-2 changed cards compared with their pre-round-2 files (git show <commit>^). Luma and high-pass checks on Sukri's portrait and Stillwater portrait streak zones. Re-ran card_qa.py on the 7 fighters and node tools/gen_store.ts --check. The 3D references for marund_gorgewalk_splash and hesmi_gorgewalk_* are newer than the shipped cards (rejected test renders), so those were judged on the card alone.

gates.cardQa: 42 cards, 4 gate misses, all blank tripwire: sukri splash 0.74, tunlan_lamplit splash 0.70, marund_gorgewalk splash 0.66, ilsheta_stillwater splash 0.65. All four cards are unchanged in round 2. No hollow, glow, streak, cracked or dots gate misses; the highest glow diagnostic is sukri_shadeprint portrait at 0.12.

scoreNote: Gauge only, against a recent LoL splash (a painted, dynamic, face-forward figure with strong value design and rim light). None of the seven reaches the 7.5 par bar. The painted cards are mostly a light regrade of the 3D (Sukri Stillwater portrait is almost identical to its reference). The 3D-shipped splashes (Ervet base and Stillwater, Marund base, Hesmi all six, Sukri Shadeprint, Ilsheta Stillwater) read as posterised clay figures on painted plates, with small static figures and single-hue light. Ardit is the strongest, with a readable silhouette and a painted pavise; Hesmi is the weakest, all 3D with wrap and eye-hole problems.

problems.fix: Drop or redo the hue op on the mouth and nose; give the wrap bands a darker value break against the hood, or warm the body.

problems.what: Both eyes still solid dark slots with no lid or pupil.
